frames.description: Every frame on the board, in the order each was first put: {frames: [{id, kind, label, file, size, width, height, x, y, rev, at, by, agent}], max}. `kind` is `html` (a page at `width` × `height`, served from frames/<id>/<file> at main) or `image` (frames/<id>/<file>; `width` null shows it at its own size). `x`/`y` null: the board lays it out. `rev` goes up at each put_frame, which redraws it. `max` is how many frames a board holds.

put_frame.description: Add a frame, or set one again whole; every open board redraws it, and only it. Write its files first (frames/<id>/…, at main: `fragment write` or `fragment sync`), then call this. `id` (a-z, 0-9, -; at most 48) names its folder. `kind` `html`: `file` its page (default index.html), `size` desktop (1440 × 900), tablet (768 × 1024), mobile (390 × 844), or custom with `width`; `height` for a taller page. `kind` `image`: `file` a .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif, .avif or .svg, `width` to scale it. `x` and `y` (both, board pixels) place it; without them the board lays it out. Answers {id, rev, created}.

remove_frame.description: Take a frame off the board; its files stay at main. Answers {removed}: 1, or 0 when it was gone already.

meta.title: Board
meta.description: An agent's designs side by side on one canvas: pages at desktop, tablet and phone widths, and screenshots, live.
